# How I write the co-op's board notes

These notes are read by the members of the harbour board, who vote on the co-op's budget and have five minutes for each note.

1. Open with the decision the board is asked to make, in one sentence. Never open with a scene or with the weather.
2. Give the cost of each option in the second paragraph, as figures from the notes.
3. Close with the date the decision is needed by.

No em dashes.
